text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Um... you two have just been<n>standing there... do
you need<n>something?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: L-like I said, it's not your fault!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um... did you... wrong me somehow?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Well, um... Rice and I made a picture<n>book, as a
birthday present for you.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It had a nice story about you riding a<n>black cat and
finding legendary coffee<n>beans. But right as we
were about to<n>bind the book...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The last page went missing! We<n>looked
everywhere but couldn't find<n>it... Sorry, it's all my
fault!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...That's okay. A picture book without<n>an ending...
sounds nice, actually.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
From what I can tell... it's the things<n>we can't see
that stir our<n>imaginations the most...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
So a missing last page... could make<n>the story even
more compelling...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
What I mean to say is... Thank you. I...<n>appreciate
your gift.
